key_factors: Hollow-fiber membrane Fiber Bundles

key_factors: Injection-molded plastic housings and structural bodies of the intake manifold and carbon canister

decisive_step: Machining the rough steel body to exact specifications, drilling the tip hole, and permanently brazing and heat-treating the carbide tip and steel body in Germany

key_factors: Woven polyester tie-down webbing strap

key_factors: The black tea leaves

key_factors: Chinese-origin major cooling and heating components, including the compressor, valve assemblies, fan assembly, and flat fin-tube assemblies
decisive_step: Manufacturing of the primary functional components (compressor, flat fin-tube assemblies, valves, and fan assembly) in China

key_factors: The piezoresistive silicon MEMS sensor die containing the complete integrated circuit and electronic functionality

key_factors: Manufacturing and cooking of the confectionery components (marshmallows, sprinkles, icing, popping candy)
